item: pytest-xdist with a fixed file placement in the test, core-only and docs-only jobs (R597, queue item 27 option B)
summary: Each full-suite leg runs -n auto --dist loadfile; conftest swaps xdist's first-free-worker order for a fixed LPT placement on the cost table. Measured locally on 4 cores: each leg 6 to 7 min against 25 to 31 in CI today; three order-dependent tests fixed (process budget idle, absent lane, map coverage cache).
